881	/-! ### Readings with a changed verdict (DS-v1)
882	
883	Each theorem below shows, on a library-reachable state, a program whose verdict depends on a
884	reading of DS-v1 recorded in the readings: the verdict of the reading formalized here, and the
885	facts that make the other reading give another verdict. -/
886	
887	/-- `release(5)` by the program, after the rewind (§62; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
888	def d11 : DState := ⟨releaseEff d9.kern 5, d9.stacks, d9.fresh⟩
889	/-- `derive(4, [3], Modify)` by the program: authority 8 on cell 3, above the current top (§60;
890	DS-v1 reading of "above"). -/
891	def d12 : DState := ⟨deriveEff d11.kern 4 [3] .modify, d11.stacks, d11.fresh⟩
892	/-- The first mark (DS-v1, §58). -/
893	def m0 : Mark := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
894	/-- A callee frame with no parameter and no local, entered after the rewind (§72; DS-v1 reading
895	of the order of `fail` and the right of §36). -/
896	def d13 : DState := ⟨enterEff d9.kern [] [], d9.stacks, d9.fresh⟩
897	
898	/-- **Reading of "a cell above m"** (DS-v1, §46). In `d12`, authority 8, active and derived from
899	`internal` 4, covers cell 3, at a position above the top of mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` but above the current
900	top too, hence not among the cells `rewind` returns (`above`): `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is `ok`. Under the
901	reading "any cell at a position at or above the top of `m`", it is rejected. -/
902	theorem reading_above :
903	    DReach K0 wst d12 ∧ d12.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ ∧
904	    st9.internal ∈ d12.kern.ancs 8 ∧ 3 ∈ st9.cells.drop m0.top ∧ 3 ∉ above st9 m0 ∧
905	    ∃ D', RewindStep K0 0 m0 d12 (.ok D') := by
906	  have r11 : DReach K0 wst d11 := .step d9_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide))))
907	  have r12 : DReach K0 wst d12 := .step r11 (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
908	  exact ⟨r12, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
909	    ⟨_, .ok (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))⟩⟩
910	
911	/-- **Readings of the order of checks and of `extra = 0`** (DS-v1, §58, §36). (1) In `d13`, a callee
912	with no right on the stack value (`¬ AdminRight`) rewinds to the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩`: the
913	outcome is `fail` (dead mark checked first); with the right of §36 checked first it is `reject`.
914	(2) In `d9`, `grow(0, 5, 0)` is rejected (`extra = 0`), while the sequence `release`, static checks,
915	in-place check, `split`, `store` of the same region would be `ok`. (3) In `d3`, `push(0, 3, 4)` asks
916	for more cells than the storage has: `fail` (availability), although the requested cells are not all
917	in the storage. -/
918	theorem reading_order :
919	    DReach K0 wst d13 ∧ ¬ AdminRight d13.kern st9 ∧ RewindStep K0 0 m1 d13 .fail ∧
920	    GrowStep K0 0 5 0 d9 .reject ∧
921	    ReleaseStep 5 d9.kern (.ok (releaseEff d9.kern 5)) ∧
922	    IssueStatic (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.entry (cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)) x5.dst ∧

import Ern.Corpus.Runner

/-!
# Corpus MM3-H: access discipline, sections A–F, H, I (test module)

The cases of corpus MM3-H of the Jalon 3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md`, §1; non-normative
design material), run on the reference kernel and arena of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` (§60–§78), plus new cases fixed by spec clauses and the
usage scenario W3 (material §5b). This is a test module: no model module imports it.

Each case is a run from `LState.init statics` (§47) by the runner (`Ern.Corpus.Runner`):
`RunsTo k statics os L` states that every step is `ok` and that `L` is library-reachable and its
kernel state `Reachable` (§57). The verdict of the step under test is stated with the relation of
its operation (`DeriveStep`, `TransferStep`, `IssueD`, `ResetD`, …) on the reached state and
decided by `decide`. Each docstring gives the expected verdict from the case's source (the
material, or the spec clause for new cases), the obtained verdict, the class (material §0, rule 5:
`N3` kernel, `Lib` library instance, `spec 3` another specification) and the positive twin (rule 2:
the same sequence without the faulty element, accepted). A case whose obtained verdict differs from
the expected one is kept with its expected verdict and marked **MISMATCH** with its cause; no case
is corrected.

Local shapes are lists of (parent, kind) (§72, §71.1); `lf` is a root leaf, `pt p` a part of `p`.
Place and authority identities are list indices (§38): `enterFrame` appends the locals and one
root authority per root local; `alloc` appends the shape and one root authority; `derive` and
`split` append the derived authorities; `issue` appends one block authority; `reset` appends one
(released) authority.

Not encoded here:
* section G (H30–H34b, H44, handle pools) and the usage scenarios W1, W2 (they use a handle pool):
  later wave (`HandlePool`);
* the cross-registry cases of §56 (a pool and an arena, or two pools, on one `internal`): later
  wave; only the arena registry exists here (`S56`);
* section J, out of the kernel, classified by the material: H38 get-or-insert cache (spec 3,
  flow-sensitive liveness, §25, §32); H39 suspended coroutine holding a `Modify` parameter
  (specs 2 and 3, §29, §81); H40 raw pointer used during a call (spec 3 and the boundary of §19,
  §81); H41 concurrent `writeShared` (spec 2, §18, §24, §68); H42 `defer free(x)` then
  `transfer(x)` (spec 3, `defer` is outside the kernel, §73, §81); H43 resource with a release
  obligation (resource specification, §7).
-/

namespace Ern.Corpus.MM3H

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena Ern.Corpus

/-! ## Test contracts and shapes (§48, §72) -/

/-- The empty test contract (§48): nothing shared, pinned, externally done or deallocable. -/
abbrev K0 : K := KD.toK {}

/-- A root leaf of a local shape (§72, §71.1). -/
abbrev lf : Option Nat × Nat := (none, 0)

/-- A leaf part of the shape element `p` (§72, §71.1). -/
abbrev pt (p : Nat) : Option Nat × Nat := (some p, 0)

/-- A structure 0 with the parts 1 and 2 (§40, §72). -/
def S2 : LocalShape := [lf, pt 0, pt 0]

/-- A write of `ls` rejected for every authority of the state is rejected for every authority
(§67.1: the writing authority is exercisable, hence exists, §43). -/
theorem write_rejected {s : S3} {ls : List Nat}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ Write3Pre s a ls) (a : Nat) :
    Write3Step a ls s .reject :=
  .reject fun hp => h a (List.mem_range.2 (exercisable_lt hp.exercisable)) hp

/-- A read of `ls` rejected for every authority of the state is rejected for every authority
(§66.2: the reading authority is exercisable, hence exists, §43). -/
theorem read_rejected {s : S3} {ls : List Nat}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ Read3Pre s a ls) (a : Nat) :
    Read3Step a ls s .reject :=
  .reject fun hp => h a (List.mem_range.2 (exercisable_lt hp.exercisable)) hp

/-- The preconditions of `transfer` other than local self-blocking prevention (§63.1–§63.7), the
fields of `TransferPre` but `noSelfLock`: used to show that §63.8 alone rejects a transfer. -/
def TransferPreBut638 (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
    SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True)

/-- Decidability of `TransferPreBut638` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPreBut638 k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPreBut638; infer_instance

/-- The static preconditions of `issue` other than local self-blocking prevention (§77.1, §77.2),
the fields of `IssueStatic` but `dstNotIn`: used to show that this clause alone rejects. -/
def IssueStaticBut (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst

/-- Decidability of `IssueStaticBut` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueStaticBut s E region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStaticBut; infer_instance

/-! ## A. Exclusivity and indirect aliasing -/

/-- Run of H01 (§72, §60): frame 1 with structure 0 (parts 1, 2, root authority 0);
`derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)` gives the first parameter, authority 1. -/
def h01o : List Op := [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 [1, 2] .modify]
/-- State reached by `h01o` (§57). -/
def h01 : LState := final K0 [] h01o

/-- **H01** (material §1 A, class N3). Two parameters derived from one local, `Modify` on the
whole, then `Observe` on a part. Expected (material): `reject`. Obtained: `reject`: the root has no
effective mode on the part, covered by the active `Modify` descendant 1 (§43 case 3), so the
`Observe` derivation exceeds it (§60.2). Twin without the first parameter: the `derive` is `ok`;
and the call with the first parameter alone is `ok` (§72). -/
theorem H01 : RunsTo K0 [] h01o h01 ∧ DeriveStep 0 [1] .observe h01.kern .reject ∧
    Runs K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 [1] .observe] ∧ Runs K0 [] (h01o ++ [.enter [1] []]) :=
  ⟨runsTo (by decide), .reject (by decide), runsTo (by decide), runsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of H02 (§72, §60): frame 1 with structure 0; authority 1, `Observe` on the whole. -/
def h02o : List Op := [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 [1, 2] .observe]
/-- State reached by `h02o` (§57). -/
def h02 : LState := final K0 [] h02o

/-- **H02** (material §1 A, class N3). `Observe` on the whole, then `Modify` on a part of the same
local. Expected (material): `reject`. Obtained: `reject`: the effective mode of the root on the
part is `Observe` (§43 case 4), below the requested `Modify` (§60.2). Twin without the
observation: `ok`. -/
theorem H02 : RunsTo K0 [] h02o h02 ∧ DeriveStep 0 [1] .modify h02.kern .reject ∧
    Runs K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 [1] .modify] :=
  ⟨runsTo (by decide), .reject (by decide), runsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of H03 (§72, §60, §65): frame 1 with X (0, parts `p` = 1 and 2) and Y (leaf 3);
authority 2, `Modify` on `p`, stored into Y. -/
def h03o : List Op := [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .derive 0 [1] .modify, .store 2 3]
/-- State reached by `h03o` (§57). -/
def h03 : LState := final K0 [] h03o

/-- **H03** (material §1 A, class N3). The value of Y holds (by `store`) a `Modify` derived on the
part `p` of X; a write of `p` through the root of X. Expected (material): `reject`. Obtained:
`reject`: the root has no effective mode on `p` (§43 case 3, §67.1). Twin without the stored
authority: `ok`. -/
theorem H03 : RunsTo K0 [] h03o h03 ∧ Write3Step 0 [1] h03.kern .reject ∧
    Runs K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .write 0 [1]] :=
  ⟨runsTo (by decide), .reject (by decide), runsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of H04, second half (§72, §60): array 0 (elements 1, 2); authority 1, `Modify` on element
1. -/
def h04o : List Op := [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 [1] .modify]
/-- State reached by `h04o` (§57). -/
def h04 : LState := final K0 [] h04o

/-- **H04** (material §1 A, class N3). Swap of two elements: by `split` then two writes, `ok`; by
two `derive Modify` of the same element, the second `reject`. Expected (material): `ok` /
`reject`. Obtained: `ok` (§61, §67) / `reject` (§43 case 3, §60.2, §85: a second derivation over
the same leaf is not legal merely by having a distinct name). Twin of the rejection: `derive
Modify` of the other element, `ok`. -/
theorem H04 : Runs K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .split 0 [[1], [2]], .write 1 [1], .write 2 [2]] ∧
    RunsTo K0 [] h04o h04 ∧ DeriveStep 0 [1] .modify h04.kern .reject ∧
    Runs K0 [] (h04o ++ [.derive 0 [2] .modify]) :=
  ⟨runsTo (by decide), runsTo (by decide), .reject (by decide), runsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of H05 (§72, §67): structure `x` (0, fields `f` = 1 and 2) and `tmp` (leaf 3); `x`
written. -/
def h05o : List Op := [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .write 0 [1, 2]]
/-- State reached by `h05o` (§57). -/
def h05 : LState := final K0 [] h05o

/-- **H05** (material §1 A, class N3). `transfer(x, x.f)`; twin `transfer(x.f, tmp)` then
`transfer(tmp, x.f)`, the destination `Moved` and of the same shape. Expected (material):
`reject` / `ok`. Obtained: `reject` (§63.2 shapes differ; §63.3 the destination is `Init` and the
footprints overlap) / `ok`. -/
theorem H05 : RunsTo K0 [] h05o h05 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 1 h05.kern .reject ∧
    Runs K0 [] (h05o ++ [.transfer 1 3, .transfer 3 1]) :=
  ⟨runsTo (by decide), .reject (by decide), runsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- **H06** (material §1 A, class N3). `derive Modify`, `derive Observe` below it, `release` of
both, then a write through the root. Expected (material): `ok`. Obtained: `ok` at every step
(§60, §62 effect: effective modes of the origins are recomputed, §43, §67). -/
theorem H06 : Runs K0 [] [.enter [] [lf], .derive 0 [0] .modify, .derive 1 [0] .observe,
    .release 2, .release 1, .write 0 [0]] :=
  runsTo (by decide)

/-! ## B. Lifetime and escape -/

/-- One static leaf, `Uninit` (§47). -/
def stS : Statics := [((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- Prefix of H07 (§60, §72, §67): the base frame passes 1, `Modify` on the static 0, to frame 1;
frame 1 writes its local `L` (1), derives 3, `Observe` on `L`, and calls frame 2 with `[1, 3]`;
frame 2 writes its local `W` (2). -/
def h07p : List Op := [.derive 0 [0] .modify, .enter [1] [lf], .write 2 [1],
  .derive 2 [1] .observe, .enter [1, 3] [lf], .write 4 [2]]
/-- Run of H07 (§64): `W` depends on 3, anchored on the caller's local `L`. -/
def h07o : List Op := h07p ++ [.depend 2 3]
/-- State reached by `h07o` (§57). -/
def h07 : LState := final K0 stS h07o

import Ern.Derived.Arena
import Ern.MM23

/-!
# DataStack, a library instance over the kernel (derivability pass 0.1, question 2)

A stack administers a storage through an authority `internal` held by the stack value, as an arena
does (candidate Spec 1 §36, §46), with library metadata: the ordered leaves of the storage, the
top, the issued blocks and the live marks. Its operations are built on kernel steps and on the
derived `issue` and `reset` of question 1 (`Ern.Derived.Arena`):

* `push`: the restricted `issue` at the top, its static clauses (§77.1, §77.2) checked before the
  room, realised by `split` of `internal` on the cells then `store` of the block into the
  destination; `fail` when no room is left;
* `mark`: a mark (stack, fresh identifier, top), metadata only;
* `rewind`: the derived `reset` on the cells above the mark, `split` of `internal` on them then
  `release` of the derived authority; `fail` for a mark that is not live in the stack;
* `grow`: in place, `release` of the last block, then the derived `issue` of a region of the same
  base and of larger size into the same destination, which is `Init`; `fail` when no room is left.

Every `ok` step of the library takes kernel steps of `Reachable` only (`dexec_reach`). The theorems
of the brief are `rewind_rejects_live_above`, `mark_no_aba` (with `rewind_removes`),
`rewind_keeps_older_marks`,
`grow_same_base`, `grow_keeps_prefix_init` and `grow_keeps_prefix_bytes` (through the refinement
`Ern.MM23`, unchanged). The decisions the brief does not settle are listed in the report
(`formal/reports/Derivability_v0.1.md`, (c) and (f)).
-/

namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool Ern.MM03.Horrors Ern.Derived.Arena

/-- A block issued by a stack: base and size in the cells of the stack, authority, destination. -/
structure Blk where
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  auth : Nat
  dst : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A mark (brief: "(pile, identifiant frais, sommet)"). -/
structure Mark where
  stack : Nat
  id : Nat
  top : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A stack (brief: "stockage, `internal`, sommet, liste ordonnée des marques vivantes"); `cells`
are the ordered leaves of the storage, its footprint at creation; `blocks` the issued blocks,
oldest first. The stack value is the holder of `internal`. -/
structure Stack where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  cells : List Nat
  top : Nat
  blocks : List Blk
  marks : List Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State of the library: the kernel state, the stacks (the identity of a stack is its index) and
the next fresh mark identifier. -/
structure DS where
  s : S3
  stacks : List Stack
  fresh : Nat

/-- Outcome of a library operation; `fail` leaves the state unchanged (§58). -/
inductive Out where
  | ok (d : DS)
  | fail
  | reject

/-- The `n` cells of the stack from the index `b`. -/
def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n

/-- The cells above the mark `m`, from its top to the current top: those that `rewind m` returns
to the available part (brief: "les régions au-dessus de `m`"). A region issued after `m` and still
below the top lies there, but not every such region does: a block grown after `m` from a base below
`m` starts below it, and a region issued after `m` and returned by an intermediate `rewind` lies
above the current top (`case_rewind_reading`; report, (f)). -/
def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)

/-- The stack seen as an administration of its storage, for `MetaRightM` and `blockOf`. -/
def Stack.arena (st : Stack) : Arena := ⟨st.storage, st.internal, [], []⟩

/-- No active authority is held by the destination (O8.2, §77.2). -/
def NoHeld (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True

instance (s : S3) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoHeld s dst) := by unfold NoHeld; infer_instance
  have hdis : (L l).alloc ≠ (L x.dst).alloc ∨
      MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L x.dst).off (L x.dst).len := by
    by_cases ha : (L l).alloc = (L x.dst).alloc
    · exact .inr (hlw.disjoint l hlt x.dst hdl hll hdleaf hne ha)
    · exact .inl ha
  exact MM23.rangeBytes_write_other (MM23.Dom.refl s2) halloc hdis

end ThmsB

/-! ## Cases (brief, question 2)

Runs from `DS.init` under the test contracts `K0`; each statement includes that the run is `ok`
(`isSome`), so that `final` is its state; every verdict by `decide`. -/

def Out.isOk : Out → Bool
  | .ok _ => true
  | _ => false

def Out.isFail : Out → Bool
  | .fail => true
  | _ => false

def Out.isReject : Out → Bool
  | .reject => true
  | _ => false

/-- The state of a run from `DS.init` (`DS.init` when a step is not `ok`). -/
def final (os : List DOp) : DS := (drun K0 DS.init os).getD DS.init

/-- The kernel state of an `ok` run of the library is reached. -/
theorem final_reach {os : List DOp} (h : (drun K0 DS.init os).isSome = true) :
    Reachable K0 [] (final os).s := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 h
  have := drun_reach (statics := []) (show Reachable K0 [] DS.init.s from .init (by decide)) hd
  simp only [final, hd, Option.getD_some]; exact this

/-- A cell of the storage `p`. -/
abbrev cellOf (p : Nat) : Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat := (some p, none, 0)

/-- One stack: frame 1 with the leaves 0 (stack value), 2, 3, 4 (cells of the storage 1), 5, 6, 7
(destinations), of root authorities 0 (on 0), 1 (on 1), 2, 3, 4 (on 5, 6, 7); `internal` 5 derived
from 1 and stored into 0; the stack 0 created on 1 with `internal` 5. -/
def setup1 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, lf, lf, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 1 .modify), .kernel (.store 5 0), .newStack 1 5]

/-- Mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, `push 2` into 5 (block 6 on `[2, 3]`), mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`, `push 1` into 6
(block 7 on `[4]`). -/
def opsR : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6]

/-- **`rewind` refused then accepted**: `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` is rejected while the block 7, derived
from `internal`, covers the cell 4 above the mark (`rewind_rejects_live_above`); after the release
of 7 it is accepted: the top returns to 2, the mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` stays, the block 6 stays. -/
theorem case_rewind :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsR).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsR) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).stacks.map
      (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) = [(2, [⟨0, 2, 6, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩])] := by
  decide

/-- The run of `case_rewind`, then a new mark: it has the top 2 of the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩` and
the fresh identifier 2. -/
def opsA : List DOp := opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩, .mark 0]

/-- **ABA** (`mark_no_aba`): the top is back at 2, the position of the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`,
and a mark `⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is live there; `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` fails, `rewind ⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is accepted. -/
theorem case_aba :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsA).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsA).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.marks)) = [(2, [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 2⟩])] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsA) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩)).isFail = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsA) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 2, 2⟩)).isOk = true := by
  decide

/-- The run of `case_aba`, then `grow` of the last block 6 by one cell. -/
def opsG : List DOp := opsA ++ [.grow 0 6 1]

/-- **`grow`**: `grow 6 1` is accepted in place: the last block becomes `⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩`, of the same
base and destination, and its authority 9 covers `[2, 3, 4]`; `grow 9 1` then fails, no cell
following; `grow 6 1` is rejected, 6 being no longer the last block. -/
theorem case_grow :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsG).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsG).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks)) = [(3, [⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩])] ∧
    (final opsG).s.afp 9 = [2, 3, 4] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsG) (.grow 0 9 1)).isFail = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsG) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true := by
  decide

/-- Two stacks: frame 1 with the leaves 0 and 8 (stack values), the storages 1 (cells 2, 3, 4)
and 9 (cells 10, 11), the destinations 5, 6, 7, 12, of root authorities 0 to 7; `internal` 8 on 1
stored into 0, stack 0; `internal` 9 on 9 stored into 8, stack 1. -/
def setup2 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, cellOf 9, cellOf 9, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 1 .modify), .kernel (.store 8 0), .newStack 1 8,
    .kernel (.derive 6 9 .modify), .kernel (.store 9 8), .newStack 9 9]

def opsS : List DOp := setup2 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .push 1 1 12, .mark 1]

/-- **Several stacks**: the guard of §56 rejects a second stack with `internal` 8, and a kernel
`newArena` with `internal` 8, which the kernel alone accepts; each stack has its top, blocks and
marks; `rewind` of stack 0 to its mark is rejected while its block 10 lives, a mark of stack 1 is not
a live mark of stack 0 (`fail`), stack 1 rewinds to its mark and pushes again. -/
theorem case_stacks :
    (drun K0 DS.init setup2).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup2) (.newStack 1 8)).isReject = true ∧
    (kexec K0 (final setup2).s (.newArena 1 8)).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup2) (.kernel (.newArena 1 8))).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsS).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsS).stacks.map (fun st => (st.internal, st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) =
      [(8, 1, [⟨0, 1, 10, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]), (9, 1, [⟨0, 1, 11, 12⟩], [⟨1, 1, 1⟩])] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsS) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsS) (.rewind 0 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩)).isFail = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsS ++ [.rewind 1 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩, .push 1 1 6])).isSome = true := by
  decide

/-- Frame use: the caller derives 6 from the root of the stack value at `Modify` and passes it to a
callee with one local 8; the callee marks the stack at entry and pushes 2 cells into its local
(block 8). At exit, `rewind` is rejected while the block lives; after `endUse` of the local, which
releases the block, `rewind` to the entry mark and `exitFrame` are accepted, and the stack is empty
again. -/
def opsF : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.kernel (.derive 0 0 .modify), .kernel (.enter [6] [lf]), .mark 0, .push 0 2 8]

theorem case_frame :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsF).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsF) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).stacks.map
      (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) = [(0, [], [])] := by
  decide

/-- Block 6 pushed on `[2, 3]`, mark `⟨0, 0, 2⟩`, block grown to `[2, 3, 4]` (authority 7), released;
then 8 derived from `internal` 5 on the cell 2, below the mark. -/
def opsE4 : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .grow 0 6 1, .kernel (.release 7), .kernel (.derive 5 2 .modify)]

/-- Marks `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` and `⟨0, 1, 1⟩` around block 6 on `[2]`; block 7 on `[3]` pushed after both
marks, released, and returned by `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩`; block 6 released; then 9 derived from
`internal` 5 on the cell 3, above the current top. -/
def opsE8 : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6, .kernel (.release 7),
    .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩, .kernel (.release 6), .kernel (.derive 5 3 .modify)]

/-- Mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, then a `push` of size 0: block 6, active, of empty footprint. -/
def opsE3 : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 0 5]

/-- **Reading of "couvre une région émise après `m`"** (review, DS-2 and DS-3): `rewind` looks at
the cells it returns (`above`). In `opsE4` the authority 8, active and derived from `internal`,
covers the cell 2 of the region `[2, 3, 4]` issued (by `grow`) after the mark `⟨0, 0, 2⟩`, below
the mark, and `rewind` is accepted (the cell 2 is not returned). In `opsE8` the authority 9 covers
the cell 3 of a region issued after `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, now above the top, and `rewind` is accepted (the
cell 3 is already available). In `opsE3` the empty block 6, issued after the mark and active, does
not block `rewind`, and stays active once the metadata forget it. -/
theorem case_rewind_reading :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsE4).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsE4).s.A[8]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) = some (true, some 5, [2]) ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsE4) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 2⟩)).isOk = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsE8).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsE8).s.A[9]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) = some (true, some 5, [3]) ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsE8) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isOk = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).s.A[6]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) =
      some (true, some 5, []) ∧
    (final (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) =
      [(0, [], [])] := by
  decide

/-- Block 6 pushed into 5, then a callee entered with only 7, a `Modify` derived from the root of 5:
it has no right on the stack value 0. -/
def opsZ : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.push 0 1 5, .kernel (.derive 2 5 .modify), .kernel (.enter [7] [])]

/-- Block 6 pushed on `[2]` into the cell 3 of the stack's own storage. -/
def opsIn : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.push 0 1 3]

/-- **Static clauses before `fail`** (§58, §77.4; review, DS-5 and Q2-GROW-ORDER): without a right on
the stack value, `grow` is rejected with or without room; `push` into an `Init` destination is
rejected, with or without room; `push` into a destination inside the requested cells is rejected
even without room, while the same `push` into an outside destination fails; `grow` into a recorded
destination inside the new region is rejected even without room (`opsIn`). -/
theorem case_static_before_fail :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsZ).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsZ) (.grow 0 6 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsZ) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])) (.push 0 1 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])) (.push 0 4 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init setup1).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup1) (.push 0 4 2)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup1) (.push 0 4 5)).isFail = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsIn).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsIn) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsIn) (.grow 0 6 5)).isReject = true := by
  decide

/-- The kernel states of the cases are reached. -/
theorem cases_reachable :
    Reachable K0 [] (final opsR).s ∧ Reachable K0 [] (final opsA).s ∧
    Reachable K0 [] (final opsG).s ∧ Reachable K0 [] (final opsS).s ∧
    Reachable K0 [] (final (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).s :=
  ⟨final_reach (by decide), final_reach (by decide), final_reach (by decide),
    final_reach (by decide), final_reach (by decide)⟩

end Ern.Lib.DataStack

# ERN — Jalon 3 : matériel pour revue unique

**Objet :** validation adversariale du Memory Model (spec 1) après les jalons 1 et 2.
**Contenu :** les trois corpus mis à jour, le contrat du pool de handles, le cadrage de la décision `NoLock`, le registre des obligations inter-spécifications.
**Statut :** matériel de conception, non normatif. Version 2 : corrections de la revue unique de GPT intégrées (contrat du pool, corpus, calendrier, scénarios Weld).

## 0. Règles du jalon 3

1. **Oracle indépendant.** Le verdict attendu d'un cas vient de sa source (clause de MM-02 v0.4, de MM-03.3 v0.3, arbitrage, ou usage déclaré), jamais du comportement des modules. Un cas sans source qui tranche est marqué « à arbitrer ».
2. **Jumeau positif.** Chaque rejet a un jumeau minimal accepté : même séquence sans l'élément fautif. Un rejet qui persiste dans le jumeau est un défaut de construction.
3. **États atteints.** Chaque cas est construit depuis l'état initial par des pas autorisés.
4. **Pas de correction silencieuse.** Un verdict obtenu différent de l'attendu est rapporté avec l'état et le pas en cause.
5. **Classement.** Chaque cas relève de : noyau MM-03 (`N3`), machine MM-02 (`N2`), raffinement (`R`), instance de bibliothèque (`Lib` : arène, pool), ou d'une autre spécification (spec 2, 3, 4, 11). Les cas d'une autre spécification restent des obligations inter-spécifications ; ils ne bloquent pas la clôture du jalon 3.
6. **Couverture.** La colonne « Couvert » indique un témoin déjà produit pendant les jalons 1 et 2, quand il est identifié avec certitude. Le jalon 3 rejoue tous les cas depuis l'état initial, couverts ou non, dans un module de cas séparé.
7. **Cible des corpus.** MM3-H et MM23-H sont encodés au jalon 3 sur les brouillons, sans modifier `MM02`, `MM03` ni `MM23`. MM2-H : ses verdicts sont révisés au jalon 3, mais sa validation exécutable reste une obligation de la reconstruction de référence ; le jalon 3 ne le déclare pas validé.
8. **Écarts connus.** Un cas dont le verdict attendu repose sur une décision non encore appliquée au brouillon (MM23-H15, H16) est encodé avec le verdict obtenu, marqué « écart connu », et inscrit au registre de reconstruction. Il n'est jamais présenté comme réussi.

---

## 1. Corpus MM3-H — discipline d'accès

### A. Exclusivité et aliasing indirect

| ID | Scénario | Attendu | Source | Classe | Couvert |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H01 | Deux paramètres dérivés d'un même local : `Modify` sur le tout, `Observe` sur une partie | `reject` | I1, A3, G1 | N3 | — |
| H02 | `Observe` sur le tout puis `Modify` sur une partie, même local | `reject` | I1, mode effectif | N3 | — |
| H03 | Valeur de Y détenant (par `store`) un `Modify` dérivé sur la partie `p` de X ; écriture de `p` par la racine de X | `reject` | I1, F4 | N3 | — |
| H04 | Échange de deux éléments : par `split` → `ok` ; par deux `derive Modify` du même élément → `reject` | `ok` / `reject` | O2, I1 | N3 | — |
| H05 | `transfer(x, x.f)` ; jumeau `transfer(x.f, tmp)` puis `transfer(tmp, x.f)` (destination `Moved`, formes identiques) | `reject` / `ok` | F5, J1 | N3 | passe 6 (cas principal) |
| H06 | `derive Modify`, `derive Observe` dessous, `release` des deux, écriture par la racine | `ok` | O3, mode effectif | N3 | — |

### B. Durée de vie et échappement

| ID | Scénario | Attendu | Source | Classe | Couvert |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H07 | L'appelé range dans une statique, via un paramètre `Modify` sur elle, une valeur ancrée sur un local de l'appelant | `reject` au `transfer` | C1, G4 | N3 | — |
| H08 | Retour ancré sur une dérivée de dérivée d'un paramètre | `ok` | C1 | N3 | passe 2 (n9) |
| H09 | Retour ancré sur un local de l'appelé via deux dérivations | `reject` | C1 | N3 | passe 2 (n9) |
| H10 | Partie contenant un accès dérivé de l'ancre A, dans un conteneur ancré sur A ; transfert de la partie, fin du conteneur, puis fin de A | `reject` à la fin de A | §1.6, B10 | N3 | — |
| H11 | Buffer d'arène rangé dans un autre bloc de la même arène | `transfer` `ok` ; `reset` `reject` tant que l'un vit | usage, A10 | Lib | — |
| H12 | `endUse` du détenteur d'une ancre pendant qu'un dépendant vit | `reject` | I3, A6 | N3 | passe 2 (n5) |

### C. Possession et libération

| ID | Scénario | Attendu | Source | Classe | Couvert |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H13 | Cycle de possession : x possède y, puis y reçoit x par transfert | `reject` | A5, `Usable` | N3 | — |
| H14 | `free` deux fois | second `reject` | A6 | N3 | — |
| H15 | `free` d'un stockage dont un sous-stockage possédé porte l'origine d'un accès détenu ailleurs | `reject` | O3.2, A6 | N3 | passe 2 |
| H16 | L'appelé reçoit par transfert une valeur possédant un stockage, le libère, rend la valeur ; l'appelant lit ce stockage | `ok`, puis `reject` | A5, A6 | N3 | — |
| H17 | `free` d'un bloc d'arène | `reject` | A6 (`Deallocable`) | Lib | passe 2 (n6) |

### D. Arènes

| ID | Scénario | Attendu | Source | Classe | Couvert |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H18 | Valeur arène transférée dans un bloc de son propre stockage | `reject` | A5 | Lib | — |
| H19 | Arène imbriquée : `reset` du parent pendant que l'enfant vit, puis après `endUse` de la valeur enfant | `reject`, puis `ok` | F1 | Lib | passe 6 |
| H20 | `alloc`, `newArena`, `issue`, `endUse`, `reset`, réémission de la même région | tout `ok` | A10, `arena_reuse_safe` | Lib | — |

# Report — corpus-kernel (brief obligation 7, kernel and arena part)

Files (new, untracked, nothing committed, no other file touched):
- `formal/Ern/Corpus/Runner.lean` (module `Ern.Corpus.Runner`, 406 lines, imports `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena`)
- `formal/Ern/Corpus/MM3H.lean` (module `Ern.Corpus.MM3H`, ~907 lines, imports `Ern.Corpus.Runner`)
Both are test modules; no model module imports them.

## Status

- `lake build Ern.Corpus.Runner Ern.Corpus.MM3H`: success; `lake env lean` on both files prints nothing (no warning).
- `axcheck.sh Ern.Corpus.Runner Ern.Corpus.MM3H`: Runner 244 constants / 94 theorems, MM3H 160 / 51, list outside propext/Quot.sound `#[]` (no `Classical.choice`).
- No `sorry/admit/native_decide/axiom/noncomputable/set_option`; no Mathlib tactic; no line over 100 characters; every `def/theorem/abbrev/structure/inductive/instance` has a docstring citing a § clause (script-checked); no draft citation (no MM-0x, pass, O4.x labels; "material" = `ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md`, non-normative, cited as the source of expected verdicts as the brief requires).
- Whole build: all 49 case `decide` proofs take ~11 s for the module.

## Runner (Ern.Corpus.Runner)

Definitions: `KD`/`KD.toK` (test contract from lists: SharedMutable, Pinned, ExternalDone, Deallocable, FreeCompat pairs; DeclaredDisjoint False; Satisfiable True) with decidability instances; `Op` (19 constructors: O1–O16 with the reference argument forms — `derive` takes a region, `enter`/`alloc` take a `LocalShape` — plus `newArena st i`, `issue i region dst`, `reset i`); `Verdict`, `verdictOf`; `KRel R A` (kernel relation read on library outcomes, registry unchanged on `ok`); `OpRel k L o` (kernel `XStep` relations for O1–O16; `NewArenaStep [] st i L`, `IssueD k i r d L`, `ResetD i L` for the arena ops); `kg`, `lstep k L o : Outcome3 LState` (computable; issue follows `IssueD`: static, availability `fail`, `SplitPre`, `StorePre`; reset follows `ResetD`: `DerivePre`, `ReleasePre`, `ResetNoDeps`); `next`; `lrun`; `final`; `RunsTo k st os L` (fields `run : lrun … = some L`, `lreach : LReach k st L`, `reach : Reachable k st L.kern`); `Runs k st os := RunsTo k st os (final k st os)`.

Theorems:
| Theorem | Statement | Clauses |
|---|---|---|
| `KD.ddSound` | `DDSound d.toK` | §61, §80 |
| `kg_sound` | `KRel (Guarded p s) L.arenas (kg L p s)` | §58 |
| `lstep_sound` | `OpRel k L o (lstep k L o)` for every op, all three outcomes | §58, §60–§78 |
| `opRel_ok` | `OpRel k L o (.ok L') → LStep k L L'` | Part XIV, §57 |
| `lstep_ok` | `lstep k L o = .ok L' → LStep k L L'` | Part XIV, §58 |
| `lrun_reach` | `LReach k st L → lrun k L os = some L' → LReach k st L'` | Part XIV, §46 |
| `runsTo` | `(lrun k (LState.init st) os).isSome = true → Runs k st os` (so `LReach` and `Reachable` of the final state) | §47, §57, Part XIV |
| `rejects` / `fails` / `oks` | computed verdict `reject`/`fail`/`ok` ⇒ `OpRel k L o .reject` / `.fail` / `.ok (next k L o)` | §58 |

Reading/representation choices of the runner (each changes no accepted program):
- `newArena` passes `others = []` to the §56 guard: library states of these runs hold arenas only. A later wave with pools must add the other registries (the `Op` and `OpRel` of `newArena` would take them).
- `final` falls back to `LState.init` on a failed run; it is only used under `runsTo`'s hypothesis, and every case states `RunsTo` (whose `run` field says the run is all `ok` and ends at the named state).
- No `LRun` soundness (only `LReach`/`Reachable`, which the brief asks for).

## Cases (Ern.Corpus.MM3H)

Twin = positive twin (material §0 rule 2). /-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s p) (pinEff s p false)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library runs (Part XIV, §46, §56, §57) -/

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code,
the registry unchanged; `newArena` with the guard of §56 against the other registries `others`;
the derived `issue` or `reset`. -/
inductive LStep (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStep k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
  | newArena {L L' : LState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
      NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStep k L L'

/-- One `ok` step of a library run in which `newArena` registers without the guard of §56
(§76.4 removed, the other preconditions of §76 kept). -/
inductive LStepNG (k : K) : LState → LState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : LState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → LStepNG k L ⟨s', L.arenas⟩
  | newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} : NewArenaBase L.kern st i →
      LStepNG k L (newArenaEff L st i)
  | issue {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat} :
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'
  | reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} : ResetD i L (.ok L') → LStepNG k L L'

/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps (Part
XIV). -/
inductive LReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : LState → Prop where
  | init : LReach k statics (LState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : LState} : LReach k statics L → LStep k L L' → LReach k statics L'

/-- Library states reachable when `newArena` registers without the guard of §56. -/
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
owning static. -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
pinned. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pin := fun _ => false }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §77.2: local self-blocking prevention, `destination` is not in `region`. -/
  dstNotIn : dst ∉ region

/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

656:/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
660:inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
662:      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
664:      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
  unfold Survives; infer_instance

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with
    | none => y
    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
  else { y with active := false }

/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with
    F := s.F.tail
    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }

/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
  authority among itself and its origins. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
  dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)

/-! ## O9 `read`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§66–§68) -/

/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places. -/
  access : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j
  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/

/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>

/-- Static preconditions of `push` of the cells `r`, checked before the room (§58, §77.4), those of
the restricted `issue` (`IssueStaticR`, §77.1 and §77.2): the stack is live, the current frame has
exercisable `Modify` on the stack value (`MetaRightM`), and the destination is a usable leaf under
exercisable `Modify`, not `Init`, holding no active authority and outside `r`. The brief's "`fail`
si pas de place" stands for both the inclusion of the region in the storage (a static clause of
§77.2) and its availability (§77.4): `push` fails when the cells requested go past the storage. -/
def PushStatic (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRightM s st.arena ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoHeld s dst ∧ dst ∉ r

instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (PushStatic s st r dst) := by
  unfold PushStatic; infer_instance

/-- The derived `issue` (question 1, `issue_as_kernel_split`): `split` of `internal` on `r`, then
`store` of the block into `dst`. -/
def IssueSeq (k : K) (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  SplitPre k s st.internal [r] ∧ StorePre (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) s.A.length dst

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (st : Stack)
    (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueSeq k s st r dst) := by
  unfold IssueSeq; infer_instance

/-- Arrival state of the derived `issue`. -/
def issueSeqEff (s : S3) (st : Stack) (r : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  storeEff (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) s.A.length dst

/-- The derived `reset` on the cells above `m` (question 1, `reset_as_kernel`): `split` of
`internal` on them, then `release` of the derived authority. -/
def RewindSeq (k : K) (s : S3) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
  SplitPre k s st.internal [above st m] ∧
    ReleasePre (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena (above st m))) s.A.length

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) :
    Decidable (RewindSeq k s st m) := by
  unfold RewindSeq; infer_instance

/-- The guard of §56 for `internal` `i`: no live arena and no live stack already uses it. -/
def Guard56 (d : DS) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ ar ∈ d.s.arenas, d.s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ i) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ d.stacks, d.s.Active x.internal → x.internal ≠ i

instance (d : DS) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 d i) := by unfold Guard56; infer_instance

  else .reject

/-- `push size dst` on the stack `j` (brief: "émission au sommet (`issue` restreint)"): the static
clauses of the restricted `issue` (`PushStatic`), then `fail` when fewer than `size` cells are left,
then the derived `issue` of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`. Its kernel part being the
derived `issue`, `push` also asks clause 5 of `store` (O8.5), which the restricted `issue` does not
(`issue_as_kernel_split`, for registered arenas). Its exact relation to `IssueR` is not proven here:
a stack is not an entry of the arena registry, and the room stands for availability. `size` may be
zero: the block then has an empty footprint, as the
restricted `issue` of the empty region (`ce_empty_region`), and it blocks no `rewind`. -/
def push (d : DS) (j size dst : Nat) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    if PushStatic d.s st (cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
      if st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length then
        if IssueSeq k d.s st (cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
          .ok { d with
            s := issueSeqEff d.s st (cellsOf st st.top size) dst
            stacks := d.stacks.set j
              { st with
                top := st.top + size
                blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, d.s.A.length, dst⟩] } }
        else .reject
      else .fail
    else .reject

/-- `mark` on the stack `j` (brief): `ok`, a mark (stack, fresh identifier, top) appended to the
live marks. -/
def mark (d : DS) (j : Nat) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st => .ok { d with
      stacks := d.stacks.set j { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, d.fresh, st.top⟩] }
      fresh := d.fresh + 1 }

/-- `rewind m` on the stack `j` (brief): `fail` when `m` is not a live mark of the stack; then the
derived `reset` on the cells above `m`, `split` of `internal` on them and `release`, which rejects
when an active authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`)
and also when the current frame cannot exercise `internal` at `Modify` (O2.1, the restricted
`MetaRight` of §78.1); `ok`: the top returns to the top of `m`, the blocks whose base is above it
are forgotten, `m` and the later marks are removed, the older marks stay (`rewind_removes`). A stack
that does not exist rejects (no stack value). -/
def rewind (d : DS) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    if m ∈ st.marks then
      if RewindSeq k d.s st m then
        .ok { d with
          s := releaseEff (d.s.addAuth (blockOf d.s st.arena (above st m))) d.s.A.length
          stacks := d.stacks.set j
            { st with
              top := m.top
              blocks := st.blocks.filter (·.base < m.top)
              marks := st.marks.takeWhile (· ≠ m) } }
      else .reject
    else .fail

/-- `grow b extra` on the stack `j` (brief: in place only). Static clauses, checked before the room
(§58): `b` is the authority of the last block, at the top, `extra` is positive ("taille plus
grande"), `b` can be released, the stack is live, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` on
the stack value (`MetaRightM`), and the destination recorded for the block is outside the new region
(§77.2, "vérifiée avant le `fail` de disponibilité"). `fail` when fewer than `extra` cells follow
the block; otherwise `release` of `b`, then the derived `issue` of the region of the same base and of
size `size + extra` into that destination. The other clauses on the destination concern the state
after the release and are those of `store`. The destination is `Init` (the first `store` wrote it)
unless the block value was moved out of it (`Moved`): the derived `issue` accepts both (O8.2), the
restricted `issue` rejects the `Init` case (§77.2, report (c)). -/
def grow (d : DS) (j b extra : Nat) : Out :=
  match d.stacks[j]? with
  | none => .reject
  | some st =>
    match st.blocks.getLast? with
    | none => .reject
    | some x =>
      if 0 < extra ∧ x.auth = b ∧ x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ ReleasePre d.s b ∧
          d.s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRightM d.s st.arena ∧
          x.dst ∉ cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra) then
        if x.base + x.size + extra ≤ st.cells.length then
          if IssueSeq k (releaseEff d.s b) st (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst then
            .ok { d with
              s := issueSeqEff (releaseEff d.s b) st (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst
              stacks := d.stacks.set j
                { st with
                  top := x.base + x.size + extra
                  blocks := st.blocks.dropLast ++ [⟨x.base, x.size + extra, d.s.A.length, x.dst⟩] } }
          else .reject
        else .fail
      else .reject

/-- Operations of a run of the library: a kernel or arena step, or a stack operation. -/
inductive DOp where
  | kernel (o : Op)
  | newStack (storage i : Nat)
  | push (j size dst : Nat)
  | mark (j : Nat)
  | rewind (j : Nat) (m : Mark)
  | grow (j b extra : Nat)

/-- The guard of §56 that a kernel `newArena` adds in the library: the registry of the stacks. -/
def KGuard (d : DS) : Op → Prop
  | .newArena _ i => ∀ x ∈ d.stacks, d.s.Active x.internal → x.internal ≠ i
  | _ => True

instance (d : DS) (o : Op) : Decidable (KGuard d o) := by
  cases o <;> unfold KGuard <;> infer_instance

/-- A step of the library. A kernel `newArena` also consults the registry of the stacks (§56). -/
def dexec (d : DS) : DOp → Out
  | .kernel o =>
    if KGuard d o then
      match kexec k d.s o with
      | some s' => .ok { d with s := s' }
      | none => .reject
    else .reject
  | .newStack st i => DataStack.newStack d st i
  | .push j size dst => DataStack.push k d j size dst
  | .mark j => DataStack.mark d j
  | .rewind j m => DataStack.rewind k d j m
  | .grow j b extra => DataStack.grow k d j b extra

/-- A run of the library: `some` of the final state when every step is `ok`. -/
def drun (d : DS) : List DOp → Option DS
  | [] => some d
  | o :: os =>
    match dexec k d o with
    | .ok d' => drun d' os
    | _ => none

end Ops

/-- The initial state of the library. -/
def DS.init : DS := ⟨S3.init [], [], 0⟩

/-! ## Inversion of the `ok` steps -/

section Inv
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]
